name: Thoropass
summary: Thoropass pairs a compliance platform with its own licensed audit team. It covers SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, HITRUST, NIST CSF 2.0 and GDPR, among others. Evidence, controls and auditor collaboration sit in one place. Prices come as a tailored quote.

evidence.capability: framework templates such as soc 2 and iso 27001

facts.text: Thoropass says it is a licensed auditor that delivers audits, with an internal audit team performing an independent assessment.
Thoropass's page lists SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, HITRUST, NIST CSF 2.0, NIS2 and GDPR among its frameworks.
Its FAQ says integrations with cloud providers, identity systems, HR platforms and ticketing tools automate evidence collection.
Thoropass describes its Audit Lifecycle Platform as combining evidence collection, control management and auditor collaboration in one place.
The FAQ says price varies by frameworks, audit scope, company size and required services, and that customers receive a tailored quote.

plans.name: Tailored quote
plans.notes: Depends on frameworks, audit scope, company size and services

hiddenCosts: Audit scope and required services change the quote, so ask whether the audit is bundled.
